nodes.label: chanceOf()
nodes.rationale: Logistic model: logit(admit rate) + k*score, returned as a range (±0.45 logit) rather than a point estimate.

nodes.label: evaluate()
nodes.rationale: Combines SAT z-score (0.6) and GPA z-score (0.4) into academic score, blends extracurricular z-score weighted more for selective colleges, then computes chance, label, net price by income bracket with out-of-state tuition adjustment.

nodes.label: track() anonymous event queue
nodes.rationale: Disabled on non-https, localhost/preview hosts, and when GPC or Do-Not-Track is set; batches up to 10 events, flushes on pagehide/visibility hidden.

nodes.label: Custom domain migration checklist
nodes.rationale: Moving off medianmatch.onrender.com requires updating canonical/og tags in index.html, robots.txt and sitemap.xml; changing API host requires updating API_URL and CSP connect-src.

nodes.label: Privacy: client-side only computation
nodes.rationale: Scores, GPA, income and activities never leave the browser; API stores only event type, short label, device type and daily-rotating anonymous visitor code; no IPs, no cookies; 13-month retention.

nodes.label: Security headers (X-Frame-Options, HSTS, Permissions-Policy)
nodes.rationale: Static site hardening: deny framing, nosniff, strict referrer, disable camera/mic/geo/payment, HSTS.
